ingredient_lines: 1 can (7 oz) Chipotle peppers in Adobe sauce
1 tsp EACH garlic & onion powder, oregano, paprika, salt, Cumin powder, ground black pepper
1/4 C neutral tasting oil or olive oil
1 thick dollop cream or sour cream - optional. We use mexican cream since it's readily available in all supermarkets around us
instruction_lines: ✅️A - Prep the chicken. Blend all ingredients listed in ✅️A into a smooth paste/sauce. Pour this paste/sauce onto a mixing bowl or shallow dish. Add chicken pieces and make sure chicken thighs are evenly coated. Cover and marinade for at least an hour or overnight. Over medium heat, grill the chicken using a griddle or flat skillet until all sides are fully cooked. Rest for few minutes and then chop into bite-sized.
✅️ B - Prepare Pico De Gallo. Click on the link below for the recipe.
✅️C - CHIPOTLE Style Guacamole is another tasty addition to your burrito bowl. The recipe is linked below.
✅️ D - Homemade Chipotle Sauce. Recipe link can be found below
✅️ E - Click on the link below for Chipotle Style Cilantro-Lemon Rice recipe
✅️F - CHIPOTLE Style Corn 🌽 Salsa. Click on the link below:

Prepare the ingredients for your burrito bowl. Add few TABLESPOONS of each prepared dish into a bowl or deep plate. See pic below. Mix them and enjoy. Another great addition to a burrito bowl is a dollop of mexican cream or sour cream. The same sides here can be used on tortillas - to make burritos. Find our burrito recipe below.
